description: Isolated source-audited draft; not admitted, qualified, or published.

routing.when_to_use: User asks to reconcile and explain realized/backtest performance, strategy/benchmark attribution, signal-cohort outcomes or a closed-trade postmortem.
when_not_to_use: No order, signing, provider, credentials, adapter installation, live activation or policy mutation.

required_inputs.name: as_of
required_inputs.description: Required timestamp, RFC3339/UTC offset as supplied.

required_inputs.name: source_snapshot
required_inputs.description: Versioned dated evidence references; references may be empty only when explicitly unresolved.

required_inputs.name: reporting_currency
required_inputs.description: ISO 4217 code or null when conversion/reporting currency is unresolved.

required_inputs.name: task_context.period
required_inputs.description: Typed domain field; use null only for an unknown scalar and preserve exact unit, sign, date and currency semantics.

required_inputs.name: task_context.ledger_snapshot
required_inputs.description: Typed domain field; use null only for an unknown scalar and preserve exact unit, sign, date and currency semantics.

required_inputs.description: Typed domain field; use null only for an unknown scalar and preserve exact unit, sign, date and currency semantics.

required_inputs.description: Typed domain field; use null only for an unknown scalar and preserve exact unit, sign, date and currency semantics.

required_inputs.description: Typed domain field; use null only for an unknown scalar and preserve exact unit, sign, date and currency semantics.

required_inputs.description: Typed domain field; use null only for an unknown scalar and preserve exact unit, sign, date and currency semantics.

required_inputs.name: task_context.benchmark
required_inputs.description: Typed domain field; use null only for an unknown scalar and preserve exact unit, sign, date and currency semantics.

expected_outputs.name: status
expected_outputs.description: Complete, partial, insufficient-evidence, or not-assessed state; complete is gated by the evidence gate.

expected_outputs.name: scope
expected_outputs.description: As-of time, horizon, reporting currency, source version and limitations.

expected_outputs.name: analysis
expected_outputs.description: Task-specific typed rows and reconciliations from definitions/analysis.

expected_outputs.name: recommendation
expected_outputs.description: Advisory proposal only; target/risk include numeric value, unit, currency and date.

expected_outputs.name: evidence_gate
expected_outputs.description: Explicit resolution of critical inputs, source-time alignment and units.

expected_outputs.name: gaps
expected_outputs.description: Typed unresolved fields and their impact/owner; unknown is not zero.

expected_outputs.name: external_effects
expected_outputs.description: Must remain empty; this analysis does not mutate external state.

forbidden_actions: Provider or broker calls; credentials; wallet access; order placement/signing/live activation.
Invented rates, thresholds, confidence, current API/runtime/version claims.
Runtime JSON/JSONL sidecar, native ledger mutation, unapproved policy change.
verification_steps: Reconcile input identities, dates, units, signs, precision, currency and provenance.
Validate output schema, evidence links, uncertainty, recommendation boundary and owner handoffs.
completion_criteria: Input and output validate against the task-specific schema; valid structural fixtures are not behavioral qualification.
Any complete result has a complete analysis, no gaps, nonempty evidence references, and all evidence-gate flags true.
Partial/unknown states preserve null metrics and explain each material gap; no missing value is silently treated as zero.
Recommendations remain advisory; external_effects is empty; no provider, order, signing, activation, or policy mutation occurs.
known_limitations: Source audit and structural draft only; no behavior qualification or current integration proof.
Draft only: eval cases are proposed_not_run; schema/structure checks do not establish behavior qualification.
The declared logical read_file/write_file aliases are not installed tools; use only host-provided fs_read/fs_write when available.
